# Paper L: number-to-source list (GENERATED by paper/make_numbers.py; do not edit)

Every number in `main.tex` and `supplement.tex` is typeset through `\V{key}`; an undefined key stops the build. Paths are relative to `ideas/L_qec_extrapolation_calibration/`. Rows tagged EXPLORATORY are post hoc and were not registered. The frozen claims ledger is `../CLAIMS.md` and is not changed by this file.

**Discrepancy found while building this list:** `RESULTS.md` and `../CLAIMS.md` state the truth validation as 17/17 cells; `results/L_truth_validation.csv` has 17 lines including its header, i.e. 16 data rows, all eligible and all with |z| <= 2. The paper reports 16/16.
